errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that in this tree.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errors.notFound: Not found — it may have been removed, or you may not have access.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.

auth.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match an account.
auth.loginSubtitle: Your family archive is private to the people you invite.
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Avoid common passwords.
auth.privacyPromise: Living relatives' details stay private by default. Nothing is shared publicly unless a tree owner turns it on — and even then only for people who have passed away.
auth.registerSubtitle: Start a private tree for your family, or accept an invitation.

account.languageHint: Saved to your profile so it follows you on other devices.
account.title: Your account

trees.createSubtitle: A tree is private: only people you invite can see it.
trees.emptyBody: Create a tree for your family, or open an invitation link someone sent you.
trees.name: Tree name
trees.privateByDefault: New trees are private and invite-only. Living people are protected by default; you can later choose to publish a deceased-only public view.
trees.subtitle: Family trees you belong to
trees.title: Your family trees

invite.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the tree admin for a new link.
invite.title: Family tree invitation

dashboard.countsNote: Counts include only people you are allowed to see.
dashboard.recentEmpty: People you open will appear here.

people.addSubtitle: Record what you know — approximate dates and names in any script are welcome.
people.emptyBody: Start with yourself or the eldest ancestor you know, then add parents, spouses and children.
people.noResultsHint: Try another spelling, a nickname, or the name in another script.
people.searchHint: Search understands spelling variants and Indic scripts (e.g. “Ramaswami” finds “Ramaswamy”, “राम” finds “Ram”).
people.searchPlaceholder: Search by any name, alias or spelling…
people.subtitle: Everyone in this tree you are allowed to see
people.title: People

badge.protectedHint: Living, minor or unknown-status: sensitive details are restricted

person.editVitalsInTimeline: Birth and death details are edited from the Timeline tab.

err.fixErrors: Please fix the errors above before saving.
err.nameRequired: Enter at least a given name, surname or the full name as recorded.

form.livingNotice: For living people and people of unknown status, full birth date, birth time, address and contact are visible to tree admins only by default.
form.namesHint: Add every form of the name you know — birth name, married name, the name in Devanagari or Tamil, aliases. Mark one as preferred.

person.genderIdentityHint: Optional, self-described. Private to the person by default.
person.removeBody: The person will be hidden from the tree. A tree admin can restore them.
person.removeBodyAdmin: The person will be hidden from the tree. You can restore them later from the audit trail.

names.fullAsRecordedHint: Exactly as written in the source, e.g. “Sri Ramaswamy s/o Krishnan”.
names.moreParts: More name parts (patronymic, house name, village prefix, honorifics)
names.scriptHint: Typing in an Indic script selects it automatically.
names.title: Names

err.endBeforeStart: The end year is before the start year.
err.endYearRequired: A range needs an end year.
err.exactNeedsDay: An exact date needs a day. Choose “Day unknown” if you don't know it.
err.exactNeedsMonth: An exact date needs a month. Choose “Year only” if you don't know it.
err.invalidDay: That day doesn't exist in this month.
err.yearOnlyNoParts: “Year only” dates can't carry a month or day.

date.originalText: Date as written in the source (optional)
date.originalTextHint: Keep the original wording, e.g. “Chaitra Shukla Navami, Samvat 2001”.

err.exactNotAllowed: A verbally recalled, approximate or unknown-source time can't be marked exact.
err.valueRequired: Enter the time, or set precision to “Unknown”.

time.exactBlocked: “Exact” is unavailable for a {{source}} time — only a record (certificate, hospital record, kundli) can support an exact time.
time.source: Where does this time come from?
time.timezoneHint: Needed to interpret a birth time correctly (IST for most Indian births).

pickers.placeHint: Type the place exactly as recorded. Pick a suggestion to link it to a known place — the recorded text is always kept.

privacy.claimantCantSeeOverrides: Current overrides are only shown to tree admins. Any level you choose here replaces the existing one.
privacy.fieldOverridesHint: Override who can see specific kinds of information. “Use default” applies the protective defaults for living people and minors.
privacy.fullDateHidden: Full date hidden by privacy settings (year shown)
privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.protectedDefaults: This person is living, a minor, or of unknown status: sensitive details (full birth date, birth time, contact, address) are restricted to tree admins unless you choose otherwise. They never appear on public pages.
privacy.settingsIntro: Only tree admins and the person themselves (after claiming the profile) can change these settings.
privacy.treeDefaultHint: Uses the tree's default privacy level.

events.deleteBody: This event and its links to sources will be deleted.
events.noneHint: Add births, marriages, migrations, education and other milestones.
events.preferredHint: When sources disagree (e.g. certificate vs kundli), keep both and mark one preferred.
events.someHidden: Some details of this event are hidden by privacy settings and won't be changed.

citations.pickSource: Choose a source or create a new one.
citations.title: Sources & citations

family.emptyHint: Add parents, a spouse, children or siblings to start building the tree.
family.otherChildren: Children not linked to a union
family.title: Family
family.unlinkBody: Only the relationship is removed; both people stay in the tree.

desc.child: Choose which marriage or partnership the child belongs to, so half-siblings are shown correctly.
desc.parent: Biological, adoptive (e.g. dattak), step, foster parent or guardian.
desc.sibling: Use this when the parents aren't recorded; otherwise siblings are worked out from shared parents.
desc.spouse: Add a marriage or partnership. Multiple and former marriages are supported.

relatives.pickPerson: Choose a person from the tree.

title.spouse: Add a spouse or partner of {{name}}

relatives.unionHint: The other parent is linked automatically.
relatives.unionStart: Date of marriage / start of union

heritage.gotraHint: Suggestions are only a typing aid. Pravara and other facts are never filled in automatically.
heritage.noInference: Heritage details are recorded exactly as the family or a source states them. Vanshavali never infers gotra, pravara, community or anything else from surnames, places or relatives.
heritage.preferredHint: Other values stay as alternatives. Conflicting values are flagged as disputed.
heritage.title: Heritage profile
heritage.valueRequired: Enter a value, or set the status to unknown / withheld.

households.deleteBody: The household and its membership history will be deleted. People are not affected.
households.emptyHint: A household records who lived together (a joint family's chulha), with the karta and changes over time.
households.kartaHint: The karta manages a Hindu undivided family (HUF).
households.name: Household name
households.noneForPerson: Not a member of any household
households.placeMustLink: Pick the place from the suggestions (or add it on the Places page first) — households store a linked place.
households.removeInsteadHint: Only for mistakes. To record that someone moved out, end the membership.
households.subtitle: Who lived together, when — with the karta and changes over time
households.title: Households

jointFamily.empty: Create branches and households to see the joint family.

jointFamily.subtitle: Households grouped by family branch, with current and former members
jointFamily.title: Joint family view

branches.deriveHint: “Derive members” adds the founder's descendants following the {{rule}} rule. You can add or remove people by hand.
branches.derived: Added {{added}} people; the branch now has {{total}} members.

branches.founderHint: Optional. Needed to derive members automatically.
branches.name: Branch name
branches.subtitle: Lines of descent within the family
branches.title: Branches

places.emptyHint: Places are added here or when you link a birth or migration place.
places.lgdHint: Local Government Directory code, if known.
places.parentHint: e.g. village within tehsil within district

places.title: Places

sources.emptyHint: Certificates, Bahi and Panda registers, family books, letters and oral histories.
sources.subtitle: Where the family's information comes from
sources.title: Sources
sources.traditionHint: Genealogy registers kept by Bahi-wale, Pandas at tirthas (e.g. Haridwar), temples or the community.
sources.urlInvalid: Must start with http:// or https://

search.hint: Search across people, places, branches and households. Each result explains why it matched.

search.subtitle: Spelling-tolerant, transliteration-aware search
search.title: Search

duplicates.subtitle: People who may have been entered twice

duplicates.title: Possible duplicates

relationship.ageDependent: Hindi distinguishes by relative age (e.g. chacha = father's younger brother, tau = elder). Birth order isn't known, so both are shown.
relationship.notFound: No connection found between these two people with the selected lineages.
relationship.subtitle: Pick two people to see how they are related
relationship.title: How are we related?

treeView.legend: Solid lines: biological · dashed: adoptive/legal · dotted: step/foster · double line: couple
treeView.noneHint: Add parents or children from the person's Family tab.
treeView.subtitle: Generation by generation; only people you're allowed to see are named
treeView.title: Family tree
treeView.truncated: This view is very large; only the nearest people are shown. Centre on someone further away to see more.

claim.messageHint: e.g. how you're related, or what's recorded here.
claim.submitted: Your claim was sent to the tree admins for review.
claim.title: Claim the profile of {{name}}

claims.subtitleAdmin: Review requests from members who say a profile is theirs

consent.intro: A record of consent given for storing or sharing this person's information (e.g. a parent consenting for a minor).
consent.required: Name, purpose and at least one data category are required.
consent.title: Consent records

members.branchScopeHint: Branch-scoped members can only edit people in that branch.
members.name: Member
members.removeBody: They will lose access to this tree immediately. Family records they added are kept.

settings.confirmPublicBody: Anyone with the link will be able to see deceased people whose privacy level is “Public (deceased only)”: their names, years and family links. Living people, minors and people of unknown status are never shown. You can turn this off at any time.
settings.confirmPublicTitle: Publish a public view of this tree?
settings.publicDeceasedHint: A read-only public page lists deceased people marked “Public (deceased only)”.
settings.publicOffHint: Only invited members can see anything in this tree.
settings.publicWarning: Only people who have died AND are set to “Public (deceased only)” appear publicly. Check their privacy levels before publishing. Birth times, addresses, contact details and notes are never public.
settings.title: Tree settings

public.banner: Public family history — deceased people only
public.deceasedOnly: Only people who have passed away and whose family chose to share them are listed.
public.noPeople: No one is shared publicly yet.

privacyHint.CUSTOM: Tree admins plus people explicitly granted access.
privacyHint.FAMILY_BRANCH: Admins and members of the same family branch.
privacyHint.INVITED_RESEARCHER: All tree members, including invited researchers.
privacyHint.PRIVATE_SELF: Only the person (once they claim the profile) and the tree owner.
privacyHint.PRIVATE_TREE_ADMINS: Only the tree owner and family admins.
privacyHint.PUBLIC_DECEASED_ONLY: Tree members; and the public, if the tree's public view is on and the person has died.
privacyHint.TREE_MEMBERS: Every tree member except invited researchers.

roleHint.BRANCH_ADMIN: Manages people and members of one branch
roleHint.CONTRIBUTOR: Adds and edits people and relationships
roleHint.FAMILY_ADMIN: Full control except deleting the tree
